title: debutly.json
description: Settings for a Debutly run. Flags on the command line override them. https://debutly.dev/docs/configuration

url.description: Where the test copy of your app runs. Never production.

goal.description: What the agents try to get done, in a sentence.

icp.description: Who your customers are. Debutly casts people like them.

unit.description: individual: one person per customer. business: an owner and teammates per customer.

tier.description: Run size. quick: 3 customers, owners only. standard: 10 with 2 teammates each. deep: 30 with 3 each.

agents.description: How many customers (people or businesses). Overrides the tier.

employees.description: Teammates per business. Overrides the tier.

maxCost.description: Refuse to start a run that could cost more than this, in US dollars.

maxSteps.description: Most actions one agent takes before it stops.

inclusion.description: off leaves out the screen-reader, low-vision, slow-connection and non-native English agents.

concurrency.description: How many agents use the app at once.

mailpit.description: Address of a Mailpit mail catcher, which gives each agent an inbox.

emailDomain.description: The domain of the agents' email addresses.

sandboxOutbox.description: Your app's sandbox outbox, so failures the test environment caused are listed apart.

app.description: The app's name in the dashboard.

evaluators.description: After the run, this many skeptical-buyer evaluators judge the pages the agents saw.

agentTokenCap.description: Most model tokens one agent may use.

agentMinutes.description: Most minutes one agent may run.

screenshotDays.description: Days to keep screenshots stored in the database.
